name: Pizzeria-Da Paolo
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Da Paolo in Tirol**

Discover authentic Italian flavors in the heart of **Tirol**! At **Pizzeria Da Paolo**, we bring you the taste of Italy with our handmade pizzas, fresh pasta, and delicious antipasti. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a creamy **Burrata**, our wood-fired pizzas are baked to perfection in our traditional stone oven.

Indulge in our signature dishes like **Spaghetti alla Carbonara** or **Risotto ai Funghi**, paired with a glass of fine Italian wine. Don’t miss our famous **Tiramisù** or **Cannoli** for dessert—pure Italian sweetness!

Located in the charming town of **Innsbruck**, **Pizzeria Da Paolo** is your go-to spot for a cozy, authentic dining experience. Come taste the sun of Italy in the mountains of **Tirol**—we’re open every day for lunch and dinner!

*Buon appetito!* 🍕
